summary: Busy, mostly positive week: Lauren returned from St Tropez, received and promptly wire-paid her first invoice, updated her link-in-bio via Mayson, and had a strategy call with Ollie. Friction came from the chat team: she discovered a $27k top spender had been blocked, flagged that 13 of her 24 whales (59% of revenue) have ghosted since takeover, and is still waiting on confirmation that chatters fixed her content boundaries (topless pricing, no porn/anal offers) raised Aug 1. She also asked for Meta ad-spend reports for the 5% paid-ads fee; Derrek's promised walkthrough call has not visibly happened. Mood: engaged and collaborative, but watchful on revenue and boundaries.
